name: tc55-min-common-api
description: The idea behind the Minimum Common API is to document the minimal collection of Web Platform APIs that ought to be implemented by Web-interoperable runtimes.

scripts.prebuild: npm run clean && mkdir out && cp -R img out
scripts.build-for-pdf: npm run prebuild && ecmarkup --verbose index.emu.html out/index.html --assets external --assets-dir out --printable
scripts.pdf: npm run build-for-pdf && prince-books --script ./node_modules/ecmarkup/js/print.js out/index.html -o out/ECMA-429.pdf
